clue.text: Opinions formed in a fleeting moment need reconsideration

definitions.text: Opinions formed in a fleeting moment
definitions.meaning: read literally, ideas that came to mind within a mere instant of time
a change of mind after thinking a matter over again

explanation.definitionFit: Taking a second look at a decision is a fresh weighing-up, and the phrase also reads as notions conceived in an instant.

clue.text: He rescues a sextet in disagreeable surroundings

indicators.note: the disagreeable word forms surroundings around the other pieces, enclosing them

parts.note: disagreeable means sour, as in a sour temper
a sextet is six, VI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A rescuer saves six people trapped somewhere unpleasant.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'disagree able' is an OCR split of one word; 'surroundings' is the container signal, with 'in' a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A rescuer is one who saves people from harm, a deliverer.

clue.text: Reach the standard required to lose one's golfing handicap

definitions.meaning: to meet expectations or be good enough
a scratch golfer plays off a handicap of zero, so improving to that level is a second sense

explanation.walkthrough: In golf, 'scratch' is a handicap of zero, the mark of an expert amateur.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to be satisfactory, and in golf it literally means improving until no handicap strokes are given.

clue.text: Fastener at one's fingertips

definitions.meaning: a small metal spike hammered in to join pieces of wood
the horny plate that grows at the end of each finger

explanation.definitionFit: A hammered metal pin joins timber, and the same word names the hard plate growing on each fingertip.

clue.text: Subjects article by me to initial scrutiny

parts.note: the definite article is the word 'the'

indicators.note: initial picks out the opening letter of the word scrutiny

explanation.surface: Someone submits topics, along with themselves, to a preliminary examination.
explanation.definitionFit: Subjects of a talk or essay are its topics.

clue.text: Broadcast about the song

parts.note: on can mean about, as in a talk on history
an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: A tune is being transmitted on radio.
explanation.definitionFit: A programme being transmitted live is going out over the airwaves.

clue.text: Share of hereditary factors transmitted in reproduction

indicators.note: share of genes reads as the gene coming before the share in the word

parts.note: genes are the units of heredity; one is taken here
a ration is an allotted share

explanation.surface: Part of one's genetic makeup is passed on when offspring are produced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' reverses the clue's order so the factor comes first; the plural 'factors' is loose, as only one is wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: Generation is the act of producing offspring or bringing something into being.

clue.text: Reliability and integrity of an investment fund

indicators.note: integrity of a fund puts the fund word first, before the integrity word

parts.note: a unit trust or investment trust is a pooled fund
worthiness is moral merit or integrity

explanation.surface: Someone praises how dependable and honest an investment fund is.
explanation.definitionFit: Being dependable and honest is the quality of deserving confidence.

clue.text: George Desmond finds crystal lined cavities

parts.note: Geo. is the old written abbreviation of George
Des is the short form of the name Desmond

explanation.surface: A man named George Desmond comes across some hollow rocks.
explanation.definitionFit: These rounded rocks are hollow inside, their interiors lined with quartz or other crystals.

clue.text: His blood-lust arouses the anger of a femme fatale

indicators.note: anger of a femme fatale places the woman's word before the anger word

parts.note: a vamp is a seductive woman who exploits men
ire is anger

explanation.surface: A man's violent passions provoke the fury of a seductive woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: a creature whose craving for blood stirs dread.
explanation.definitionFit: The undead monster of legend drinks blood, so its thirst for gore is its defining trait.

clue.text: Fashion certain to go to a monk's head

parts.note: the ton is an old word for high fashion or society
sure means certain

explanation.surface: A style is bound to suit a monk's haircut.
explanation.definitionFit: A monk's shaved crown is the bare patch on his head left by ritual shaving.

clue.text: Responsibility which means nothing to students

parts.note: O is the figure zero, nothing
NUS is the National Union of Students, the UK students' body

explanation.surface: A duty that students consider of no importance.
explanation.definitionFit: A burden or duty laid upon someone is the obligation they carry.

clue.text: Outraged by dead secret resolution

indicators.note: resolution in the sense of breaking up and reforming, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is scandalised by the solving of a deceased person's secret.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolution' rearranges the letters of DEAD SECRET.
explanation.definitionFit: Violated, in the sense of a sacred place treated with sacrilege.

clue.text: Cancellation of story-time leads to a reprimand

definitions.meaning: read literally, the narrating of a tale called off

explanation.definitionFit: A scolding is the second sense; the first reads the phrase as narration being called off.

clue.text: Desert the lady? Oh yes!

parts.note: to rat is to desert or betray
her refers to a woman

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to abandon a woman, and gets an eager yes.
explanation.definitionFit: An emphatic British exclamation of agreement, like 'very much so!'

clue.text: A woman is a crown to her husband" (Proverbs, Ch. 12)

definitions.text: A woman is a crown to her husband" (Proverbs, Ch. 12)

parts.words: A woman is a crown to her husband" (Proverbs, Ch. 12)
parts.note: a quotation with a word missing before 'woman'; Proverbs 12:4 names the good, morally upright kind of wife

explanation.walkthrough: The printed clue has lost its blank and opening quote: the verse runs 'A ___ woman is a crown to her husband'.
explanation.definitionFit: The King James Bible's Proverbs verse praises a wife of moral excellence and goodness.

clue.text: He pays attention to silent movie with little hesitation

indicators.note: movie read as 'moving', so the letters of silent are shifted about

parts.note: er is a short sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A cinema-goer watches a silent film, pausing only briefly.
explanation.definitionFit: One who hears and heeds what is said.

clue.text: Deny record mail distribution

parts.note: a gramophone record is a disc

indicators.note: distribution spreads the letters of mail about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone denies a record was sent out by post.
explanation.definitionFit: To renounce or refuse to acknowledge something is to deny it.

clue.text: Physician who has to patch things up

definitions.meaning: to repair or tamper with it

explanation.definitionFit: A medical practitioner, and as a verb to fix or tamper with something.

clue.text: Shakespearean clown gaining the lowest score

definitions.meaning: Nick ..., the comic weaver in A Midsummer Night's Dream
finishing last, at the foot of the table

explanation.definitionFit: The weaver given an ass's head in A Midsummer Night's Dream, and the lowest place in a ranking.

clue.text: Former American president is one to hearten an angry child

indicators.note: read as 'to put in the heart', so the word for one goes inside

parts.note: mad means angry
a son is a child
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An ex-president's role is to encourage a cross youngster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to hearten' is read as put into the heart of MAD SON.
explanation.definitionFit: James Madison was the fourth US President, from 1809 to 1817.

clue.text: Culinary skill in Tasmania

parts.note: a hob is a cooking surface, used for culinary work
art is skill

explanation.surface: Someone shows cooking skill on the island state of Tasmania.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: the answer is the capital city of Tasmania, the Australian island state.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasmania's capital city is a place in that island state.

clue.text: Enthronement of firm king has appeal to the country

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
R is short for rex, Latin for king
O is the exclamation used in an appeal or invocation, as in 'O Lord'
a nation is a country

explanation.surface: A firm's monarch is crowned and addresses the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: The ceremony of crowning a monarch is when they take the throne.

clue.text: The generous type

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'The generous type', defines KIND, not the answer RIND; no wordplay reaches RIND, so the clue or answer is misprinted.

clue.text: Spots the champion around noon

indicators.note: the champion word goes around the noon letter, enclosing it

parts.note: an ace is a champion or expert

explanation.surface: The best player is spotted at around midday.
explanation.definitionFit: Spots are pimples, the skin complaint common in teenagers.

clue.text: Like an overcoat which has seen better days

definitions.text: Like an overcoat which has seen better days

parts.words: Like an overcoat which has seen better days
parts.note: describes a coat that is old and threadbare from long use, and one worn outside the other clothes

explanation.definitionFit: Shabby and used up from long service, as an old coat becomes.

clue.text: Toxophilitic residents of Ambridge

parts.note: toxophily is the sport of shooting with bow and arrow; Ambridge is the village in a long-running BBC radio soap named after its central family

explanation.walkthrough: The BBC radio soap set in the village of Ambridge is named after its farming family; toxophilitic means devoted to bowmanship.
explanation.definitionFit: People who shoot with bows, and the surname of the family at the heart of the radio soap.

clue.text: Adam and I!

definitions.meaning: in Genesis, the man created before all others
the pronoun used by the speaker, in grammar the speaker's form

explanation.definitionFit: Adam was the earliest human in Genesis, and 'I' is the grammatical person of the speaker.
